verdict.rationale: GitBook's own docs list a 'GitBook CLI' page under docs-as-code (gitbook-docs-28), but community evidence directly quotes the GitBook team stating 'the CLI is no longer under active development' as GitBook shifted focus to the SaaS platform (gitbook-comm-17), and other users describe migrating away due to the platform's move away from open, tool-driven workflows (gitbook-comm-13, gitbook-comm-15). No runtime probe confirms the CLI is installable or functional today, unlike the MCP server which is independently verified live. Missing for 10: independent confirmation the CLI still installs/works, evidence of AI-native CLI features (agent scripting, non-interactive automation), and resolution of the deprecation claim.
